title: Near surface Ozone (O3)
description: Near surface concentration of ozone (O3) estimated by NASA's GEOS-CF model.

mp4.note: The MP4 starts 24 h after the PNG frames (verified against the burned-in date).

colorbar.note: x1 is exclusive. Pixels 463-464 are a white border, not the 60 ppbv colour.

encoding.model: pixel = a(v)*colorbar(v) + (1-a(v))*background, background = greyscale Earth (black ocean)
encoding.note: Opacity measured from the frames. Values below ~18 ppbv are drawn nearly transparent and are rough.

disclaimer: Values are decoded from visualization colours (approximate), not raw science data.
